observables: alive cells and mean growth rate of each species at 600/1200/1800 min; time of the first doubling of M. barkeri; sign and median of the acetate, H2, CO2 and glucose exchange of each species; median H2 and acetate concentration in the cells' voxels; cap fraction and median cap ratio (recorded bound / Michaelis-Menten bound) per substrate; ledger residual
